label: Taking screenshots
description: Taking screenshots using the Windows snipping tool
content: 👉 **To take a screenshot**, you can use the ✂️ **Windows snipping tool**.
**Here's how:**
* `Win` + `Shift` + `S` to open the snipping tool, then select the area you want to capture.
* The screenshot will be copied to your clipboard, and you can paste it into your message with `Ctrl` + `V`.
🔍 Check out the full tutorial for [Taking screenshots](<https://docs.mobiflight.com/guides/taking-screenshots/>)

label: MobiFlight Installation Path
content: 👉 **MobiFlight installs to** 📂`%LocalAppData%\MobiFlight\MobiFlight Connector`
[MobiFlight Installation Path](<https://docs.mobiflight.com/guides/installation-path/>)

label: Try out a GitHub PR Build
description: Try out a GitHub Pull Request Build
content: 👉 **Try out a GitHub Pull Request Build** to see if this version resolves your issue.
* **Download the latest zip-file** from the Pull Request (PR) on Github - scroll all the way down to find the latest version.
* **Extract the downloaded zip-file** to a temporary folder.
* **Extract the zip-file** inside the temporary folder. A new sub-folder will be present.
* **Run the `MFConnector.exe`** inside the sub-folder.
Let us know if your issue is resolved with this version! 🙏 **Thank You!**
